lines.zh: 我四条腿压着地面走过去。
lines.en: I cross the ground on four legs.
My body is a size larger than my kin.
Bones push against my hide.
Every step is sure.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，找活的东西。
lines.en: I move along the wall, hunting.
Saliva drips from my jaw.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边低低地哼。
lines.en: As I walk, I growl low.
Bushes snap beneath me.
I turn toward the village.
I walk slowly and never stop.
I skirt a heap of rubble.

lines.zh: 我走到篱笆前，低头看了看。
lines.en: I reach the fence and look down at it.
One foot snaps the planks.
I follow a trail of blood.
I stop in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我站在路中间，喘得很响。
lines.en: I stand in the road, breathing loud.
My teeth are longer than they were.
I cannot recall that name anymore.
The mutation made me this.
I raise my head and sniff.
The air is full of smells.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴边淌下的唾液。
lines.en: I lick the saliva from my jaw.
Something itches under my bones.
I shake the hide across my back.
Nothing living here.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子慢慢调过去。
lines.en: I swing my whole body round.
My bones ache. I'm still growing.
A little bigger each day.
I crouch outside the fence and wait.
They always come out.
It isn't dark yet. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我抬起脑袋，涎水还在滴。
lines.en: I lift my head, still dripping.

lines.zh: 我站起来比量，你比我小。
lines.en: I rise to my full height. You're smaller than me.
That pleases me.

lines.zh: 你的皮下面有东西在跳。
lines.en: Something beats beneath your skin.

lines.zh: 我慢慢凑近，闻你的脖子。
lines.en: I lean in and sniff your neck.
I shift a step forward. You back away.
I follow half a step. Don't run.
It's more fun if you run.
My teeth are badly aligned.

lines.zh: 牙生得歪歪扭扭，咬起来照样管用。
lines.en: My teeth sit crooked and still work.
I can hear your heart.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat perfectly.
A growl sticks in my throat; I back off.
My hide splits and the blood is dark.

lines.zh: 皮裂开的时候，我没有叫。
lines.en: When the hide split, I made no sound.
The pain only hollows me out more.
My tongue drags over the wound.

lines.zh: 腿一软，我跪下去又站起。
lines.en: My legs buckle, then lift me again.
I brace against the ground.
Braced on the ground, something rattles in my bones.

lines.zh: 血黑成那样，我照旧立着。
lines.en: The blood runs black. I'm still up.
I raise my head and stare.
What's on the wind is meat.

lines.zh: 我闻出来了，你手里是肉。
lines.en: I can tell. That's meat in your hand.

lines.zh: 离得这么远，我也闻得出来。
lines.en: Even at this distance, I can tell.
Stop holding it up. Throw it.

lines.zh: 那一点肉，一眨眼就下肚。
lines.en: That scrap vanished in a blink.

lines.zh: 眨眼吞干净了，还差得远。
lines.en: Swallowed in a blink. Far from enough.
I lick my teeth. I want more.

lines.zh: 你挪得太磨蹭，来不及了。
lines.en: You’re too slow getting clear.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腕子，我不吃手。
lines.en: I watch your wrist. I don't eat hands.
One bite. This piece is fresh.
It makes a sound when I chew.
I lower my head and eat off the ground.
You should eat something too.
You should eat too. No. You don't need to.
If you hold still, I'll feed you.
I lick the juice off the ground.
You hit me and I hold.

lines.zh: 你顶过来，我四条腿钉住。
lines.en: You push; my four legs hold their ground.
Bones push out. My hide is thick.

lines.zh: 这一撞之后，你被弹开了。
lines.en: After that collision, you bounce off.
I bare my teeth and look down at you.

lines.zh: 这一撞让你露出了破绽。
lines.en: That bump opened you up.

lines.zh: 这一撞露出破绽，我抬起前爪。
lines.en: The bump opens you up. I raise a forepaw.
Half-raised, then lowered again.

lines.zh: 盯着你看了一会，还不是时候。
lines.en: After watching you, not yet.
I go around you and keep walking.

lines.zh: 变异之后，繁殖变得不一样。
lines.en: After mutation, breeding changes.
We don't need that anymore.
Kin only tear at each other.
I carry old bite marks.
I lick one of them.

lines.zh: 舔了舔旧咬痕，已经不疼了。
lines.en: I lick an old bite. It doesn't hurt anymore.
I press on across the ground.
Things that move matter more.

lines.zh: 凡会喘气的都算数，眼前算你一个。
lines.en: Anything that breathes counts. You’re one.
At that thought, I turn my head.
I take it in my teeth and toss my head.
This thing in my mouth is mushy.
I pick it up and chew twice.

lines.zh: 咽下去的时候，味道不对。
lines.en: On the way down, the taste is wrong.
Only after chewing do I spit it out.

lines.zh: 味儿是怪的，我照样咽下。
lines.en: The taste is off. I swallow it anyway.
My tongue is rough.

lines.zh: 舔过的东西都会留味道。
lines.en: Everything I lick keeps my scent.
I remember this place.

lines.zh: 我转过身，朝村子那边挪。
lines.en: I turn and shamble toward the village.
Over by the fence, you moved.

lines.zh: 唾液滴到地上，我抬起头。
lines.en: Saliva drips to the ground. I raise my head.
My mouth starts to water.

lines.zh: 我把四条腿曲起来，伏低。
lines.en: I bend four legs and sink low.
Four legs load up.

lines.zh: 这一排屋子里，我选定你了。
lines.en: Out of all these houses, I've chosen you.
Two streets away, you smell good.
I head your way.
Four legs drive. Here I come.
I want you watching. Don't close your eyes.
At the end of the alley, you're running.
Four legs are faster than you.
Grass juice on my feet.
You back to the wall; I keep coming.

lines.zh: 你拐进巷子，巷子有尽头。
lines.en: You duck into the alley. It has an end.
I walk in slowly.
At the end, you're pressed to the wall.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，我不着急。
lines.en: I walk step by step. I'm in no hurry.
The iron in your hand glints.
Nowhere left for you. Now.

lines.zh: 我的爪子压向你的胸口。
lines.en: My claws press into your chest.
Your armor dents.

lines.zh: 我一口钳住了你那条胳膊。
lines.en: My jaws clamp your arm.
My teeth press toward the bone.
I bite down. You cry out.
I fling you to the ground.
Four legs pin you.

lines.zh: 四条腿压着你，你还在挣。
lines.en: Four legs pin you. You're still struggling.
Do not watch my mouth; watch my claws.
Don't move. It'll be quicker.

lines.zh: 从土里拱出来的时候，我还在变。
lines.en: I was still changing as I pushed up through the soil.

lines.zh: 第一次站起来，腿是弯的。
lines.en: The first time I stood, my legs were bent.

lines.zh: 站起来时腿是弯的，后来直了。
lines.en: My legs were bent when I stood. Later they straightened.
I raise my head and smell the village.
That smell makes me hungry.
With my first step, a plank gives way.
Another step, and I’m closer.

lines.zh: 再迈一步，牙床又胀了一分。
lines.en: Another step, and my gums ache with growth.
I walk through. The fence breaks.

lines.zh: 我从废墟里走出来，很饿。
lines.en: I walk out of the rubble, starving.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮上，我滚进土里。
lines.en: Fire reaches my hide; I roll in the dirt.
I land and the ground cracks.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，我四条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Water reaches my throat; all four legs thrash.

lines.zh: 炸声过后，我趴在碎砖里。
lines.en: After the blast I lie in broken bricks.
The arrow sticks in my shoulder; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 一道光锁死四肢，我挣不开。
lines.en: Light locks my four legs. I can’t move.

lines.zh: 四处没活物，我饿得打颤。
lines.en: Nothing alive here. I shake with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，四肢发麻。
lines.en: Lightning lands on my back; my limbs go numb.
I fall and never hit bottom.
